scope: Dallas County (Dallas, Irving, Garland, Mesquite, Grand Prairie) - health & opportunity

records.name: Parkland Financial Assistance (PFA)
records.description_en: Helps pay for care at Parkland Hospital and Parkland community health centers. It is not insurance, but it lowers what you pay for doctor visits, hospital care, and medicine.
records.description_es: Le ayuda a pagar la atención en el Hospital Parkland y en los centros de salud de Parkland. No es un seguro, pero baja lo que usted paga por consultas médicas, atención en el hospital y medicinas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Dallas County residents with household income below 250% of the Federal Poverty Income Level. Income and household size are checked.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en el condado de Dallas y cuyo ingreso familiar es menor al 250% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza. Se revisan sus ingresos y el tamaño de su familia.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online (new or renewal), call 214-590-8831, or go in person to Patient Financial Services at the Parkland Tower Garage. Financial counselors at Parkland health centers can also help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente su solicitud en línea (nueva o de renovación), llame al 214-590-8831 o vaya en persona a Servicios Financieros para Pacientes en el Parkland Tower Garage. Los consejeros financieros de los centros de salud de Parkland también le pueden ayudar.
records.address: Parkland Tower Garage, 2021 Medical District Drive
records.cost: Free to enroll; co-pays based on Parkland's patient payment chart
records.notes: Parkland says it offers translation in 166 languages; forms and the document checklist are in English and Spanish. Covers emergency, primary, specialty and hospital care, pharmacy, lab and radiology. Applying does not guarantee approval. Renewals for coverage expired less than 6 months ago use the renewal form: https://www.parklandhealth.org/renew-parkland-financial-assistance

records.description_en: A Parkland neighborhood health center with primary care for children and adults, such as check-ups, sick visits, and care for long-term health problems.

records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the public. Uninsured Dallas County residents can apply for Parkland Financial Assistance to lower costs.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto al público. Si vive en el condado de Dallas y no tiene seguro médico, puede pedir la Asistencia Financiera de Parkland para pagar menos.
records.how_to_apply: Call the health center to make an appointment. Ask a Parkland financial counselor about Parkland Financial Assistance if you have no insurance.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al centro de salud para hacer una cita. Si no tiene seguro, pregunte a un consejero financiero de Parkland por la Asistencia Financiera de Parkland.
records.cost: Sliding costs with Parkland Financial Assistance; insurance accepted
records.notes: Appointments line: (214) 266-4000. Pharmacy: (214) 266-1300. Has lab, pharmacy and radiology.

records.name: Los Barrios Unidos Community Clinic (LBU)
records.organization: Los Barrios Unidos Community Clinic, Inc.
records.description_en: A community health center with family medicine, children's care, women's health, prenatal care, dental, behavioral health, and pharmacy. It has clinics in West Dallas, Oak Cliff, and South Oak Cliff.
records.description_es: Un centro de salud comunitario con medicina familiar, atención para niños, salud de la mujer, cuidado prenatal, dentista, salud mental y farmacia. Tiene clínicas en West Dallas, Oak Cliff y South Oak Cliff.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the community, including people without insurance. Staff can help you find out if you qualify for insurance or other help.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto a la comunidad, incluso a personas sin seguro médico. El personal le puede ayudar a saber si califica para un seguro u otra ayuda.
records.how_to_apply: Call (214) 540-0300 to make an appointment. School and sports physicals do not need an appointment. For help with insurance or eligibility, call (214) 752-8204.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (214) 540-0300 para hacer una cita. Los exámenes físicos para la escuela y los deportes no necesitan cita. Para ayuda con seguro o para saber si califica, llame al (214) 752-8204.
records.notes: Other sites: LBU Pediatrics, 3111 Sylvan Ave., Dallas 75212; LBU Oak Cliff, 4732 W Illinois Ave., Dallas 75211; LBU South Oak Cliff, 5787 S Hampton Rd. #365, Dallas 75232; T.D. Marshall school-based clinic, 915 Brookmere Dr., Dallas 75216. WIC appointments: (214) 761-0956 (WIC site listed at Texas Native Health, 1283 Record Crossing Rd, Dallas 75235). Eligibility/insurance help: (214) 752-8204. Hours and fees were not listed on the official page; call to ask.

records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone, including people without insurance, people who cannot pay, and refugees. Everyone must enroll as a patient.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto para todos, incluso personas sin seguro, personas que no pueden pagar y refugiados. Todos deben inscribirse como pacientes.
records.how_to_apply: Call to enroll as a patient and make an appointment. Online booking is also offered on the HHM Health website.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para inscribirse como paciente y hacer una cita. También puede hacer su cita en línea en el sitio web de HHM Health.
records.cost: Low cost; $4 generic medicines at HHM pharmacy; call to ask about fees
records.notes: Main HHM Health phone. Services at this site include adult medicine, pediatrics, women's health, HIV/Hepatitis C care, vision, imaging, behavioral health/psychiatry and nutrition. HHM Health says translators for various languages are available. After-hours line: (214) 221-0855.

records.name: Agape Multidisciplinary Clinic
records.organization: Agape Clinic with UT Southwestern students
records.description_en: A free evening clinic for adults and children. It offers check-ups, diabetes and blood pressure care, vaccines, and some medicines when available.
records.description_es: Una clínica gratis por la noche para adultos y niños. Ofrece chequeos, cuidado de la diabetes y la presión alta, vacunas y algunas medicinas cuando hay.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to anyone. There are no income, zip code, or insurance requirements.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierta para todos. No hay requisitos de ingresos, código postal ni seguro médico.
records.how_to_apply: Contact the clinic to ask about the next clinic night. Only a few patients (3-6) are seen each clinic.
records.how_to_apply_es: Comuníquese con la clínica para preguntar cuándo es la próxima noche de clínica. Solo atienden a pocos pacientes (de 3 a 6) cada vez.
records.hours: 6-9 p.m., bi-weekly (1 pediatric and 1 family medicine clinic per month)
records.notes: Student-run clinic with limited capacity (3-6 patients per clinic); not for emergencies. The UTSW page lists only an email contact for the clinic operations coordinator (Natalie.Hackman@UTSouthwestern.edu).

records.name: City of Dallas WIC Program
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy food benefits on an EBT card, nutrition classes, and breastfeeding help to pregnant women, new moms, babies, and young children.
records.description_es: WIC da beneficios para comprar comida saludable con una tarjeta EBT, clases de nutrición y ayuda con la lactancia a mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes, bebés y niños pequeños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For pregnant women, new mothers, infants, and children under 5 who live in Dallas County, meet income rules, and have a nutrition need. U.S. citizenship is not required.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes, bebés y niños menores de 5 años que viven en el condado de Dallas, cumplen con los límites de ingreso y tienen una necesidad de nutrición. No necesita ser ciudadano de EE. UU.
records.how_to_apply: Call 214-670-7200 or text 1-855-957-5424 to find a clinic and make an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 214-670-7200 o envíe un mensaje de texto al 1-855-957-5424 para encontrar una clínica y hacer una cita.
records.notes: Runs 16 clinics across Dallas County; many open six days a week. Email: ASKWIC@dallas.gov. Live chat on the website.

records.name: NTBHA 24/7 Crisis Line and Behavioral Health Services
records.description_en: A 24/7 crisis line for mental health and substance use emergencies. NTBHA also connects people to mental health treatment, recovery services, and help paying for medicine.
records.description_es: Una línea de crisis abierta las 24 horas, los 7 días de la semana, para emergencias de salud mental y de uso de drogas o alcohol. NTBHA también le conecta con tratamiento de salud mental, servicios de recuperación y ayuda para pagar medicinas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people of all ages, whether or not they can pay.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de todas las edades, puedan pagar o no.
records.how_to_apply: In a crisis, call 866-260-8000 any time. To get care in Dallas County, call (800) 241-8716 or email CCReferrals@ntbha.org.
records.how_to_apply_es: Si está en crisis, llame al 866-260-8000 a cualquier hora. Para recibir atención en el condado de Dallas, llame al (800) 241-8716 o escriba a CCReferrals@ntbha.org.
records.cost: Free crisis line; services regardless of ability to pay, with sliding fee discounts
records.notes: Also serves Ellis, Hunt, Kaufman, Navarro and Rockwall counties. Second crisis number: (844) 672-5700. General line/text: (214) 366-9407; toll-free (877) 653-6363. Dallas County care coordination: (800) 241-8716. In a life-threatening emergency call 911.

records.name: Metrocare Services
records.description_en: The largest mental health provider in Dallas County. It offers counseling, psychiatric care, substance use treatment, and services for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities or autism, for children and adults.
records.description_es: El proveedor de salud mental más grande del condado de Dallas. Ofrece consejería, atención psiquiátrica, tratamiento para el uso de drogas o alcohol y servicios para personas con discapacidades intelectuales y del desarrollo o autismo, para niños y adultos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For children, teens, and adults in the Dallas area, including veterans and people who are homeless. No referral is needed.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para niños, adolescentes y adultos del área de Dallas, incluidos veteranos y personas sin hogar. No necesita una referencia.
records.how_to_apply: Call Metrocare and ask for the Connect Center, which guides new patients to the right service. No referral is needed.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Metrocare y pida hablar con el Connect Center, que guía a los pacientes nuevos al servicio correcto. No necesita una referencia.
records.notes: Toll-free: (877) 283-2121. For a mental health crisis, call the NTBHA crisis line (866) 260-8000. Metrocare Primary Care closed May 31, 2026 - do not refer for primary medical care. Also offers housing/homelessness and veterans services.

records.name: Suicide & Crisis Center of North Texas 24-Hour Crisis Line
records.organization: Suicide & Crisis Center of North Texas
records.description_en: A free, private 24/7 phone line where trained volunteers listen and help people who are thinking about suicide or are in a mental health crisis.
records.description_es: Una línea telefónica gratis y privada, abierta las 24 horas, donde voluntarios capacitados escuchan y ayudan a personas que piensan en el suicidio o están en una crisis de salud mental.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in crisis can call, including people with depression, anxiety, PTSD, or substance use concerns.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona en crisis puede llamar, incluso personas con depresión, ansiedad, trauma (PTSD) o problemas con drogas o alcohol.
records.how_to_apply: Call 214-828-1000 any time, day or night.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 214-828-1000 a cualquier hora del día o de la noche.
records.notes: Also offers crisis debriefing, teen suicide prevention education, and support for suicide loss survivors. For an emergency call 911 or 988.

records.name: NAMI North Texas
records.organization: National Alliance on Mental Illness North Texas
records.description_en: Offers support groups, classes, and peer support for people with mental illness and their families.
records.description_es: Ofrece grupos de apoyo, clases y apoyo entre compañeros para personas con enfermedades mentales y sus familias.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For adults, youth, and families affected by mental health conditions.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para adultos, jóvenes y familias afectados por problemas de salud mental.
records.how_to_apply: Call (214) 341-7133 or check the website for support group and class schedules.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (214) 341-7133 o vea el sitio web para conocer los horarios de los grupos de apoyo y las clases.
records.notes: Also serves Rockwall, Denton and Collin counties. Not a crisis line. Email: info@NAMINorthTexas.org. Cost not listed on the page.

records.name: Child Care Services (Child Care Assistance) - Dallas County
records.organization: Workforce Solutions Greater Dallas with ChildCareGroup
records.description_en: Helps pay for child care so parents can work, look for work, or go to school or training. Families choose a licensed or registered child care provider.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar el cuidado de niños para que los padres puedan trabajar, buscar trabajo o ir a la escuela o a una capacitación. Las familias escogen un proveedor de cuidado infantil con licencia o registrado.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Dallas County families who meet federal income rules and need care while working, job hunting, or in school.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias del condado de Dallas que cumplen con los límites de ingreso federales y necesitan cuidado mientras trabajan, buscan trabajo o estudian.
records.how_to_apply: New families apply online through Texas Child Care Connection (TX3C). You can also get help at a Workforce Solutions Greater Dallas center or by calling ChildCareGroup's child care assistance line.
records.how_to_apply_es: Las familias nuevas presentan su solicitud en línea en Texas Child Care Connection (TX3C). También puede recibir ayuda en un centro de Workforce Solutions Greater Dallas o llamando a la línea de ayuda para cuidado infantil de ChildCareGroup.
records.cost: Free to apply; parent share of cost may apply
records.notes: Since Jan 13, 2025 new applications go through the statewide Texas Child Care Connection (TX3C). ChildCareGroup main line: (214) 630-7911. Hours and address are for ChildCareGroup (https://www.childcaregroup.org/). There may be a waiting list. Relay Texas 711.

records.name: Head Start and Early Head Start of Greater Dallas
records.organization: Head Start of Greater Dallas, Inc.
records.description_en: Free early learning programs for babies, toddlers, and preschoolers, with health, nutrition, and family support services.
records.description_es: Programas gratis de aprendizaje temprano para bebés, niños pequeños y niños en edad preescolar, con servicios de salud, nutrición y apoyo para la familia.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Dallas County families with low income. Early Head Start serves babies and toddlers (ages 0-3) and Head Start serves ages 3-5.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de bajos ingresos del condado de Dallas. Early Head Start atiende a bebés y niños pequeños (de 0 a 3 años) y Head Start atiende a niños de 3 a 5 años.
documents_needed: Proof of income (such as tax forms or benefit statements)
records.how_to_apply: Apply online or call the enrollment line at 1-866-474-3338. Enrollment is open all year.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente su solicitud en línea o llame a la línea de inscripción al 1-866-474-3338. La inscripción está abierta todo el año.
records.notes: General office: (972) 283-6400 (source: https://hsgd.org/contact-us/). Enrollment number is written 1-866-HSGD-EDU.

records.name: Dallas ISD Food and Child Nutrition Services
records.description_en: Runs school breakfast and lunch for Dallas ISD students and can answer questions about school meals and meal accounts.
records.description_es: Maneja los desayunos y almuerzos escolares para los estudiantes de Dallas ISD y puede contestar preguntas sobre las comidas escolares y las cuentas de comida.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For students enrolled in Dallas ISD schools and their families.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para estudiantes inscritos en escuelas de Dallas ISD y sus familias.
records.how_to_apply: Call Food and Child Nutrition Services at (972) 925-3700 with questions about school meals.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Servicios de Alimentos y Nutrición Infantil al (972) 925-3700 si tiene preguntas sobre las comidas escolares.
records.notes: The page did not describe the free/reduced meal application or whether meals are free for all students; confirm with the district.

records.name: WorkReadyU (Adult Education, GED, ESL and Job Training)
records.description_en: Offers job training for in-demand careers, GED classes, a high school diploma option, and English (ESL) classes for adults.
records.description_es: Ofrece capacitación laboral para carreras con mucha demanda, clases de GED, una opción para sacar el diploma de preparatoria y clases de inglés (ESL) para adultos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Dallas County residents who do not have a U.S. bachelor's degree. You need a valid photo ID; students under 18 need parent paperwork.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en el condado de Dallas y no tienen un título universitario (licenciatura) de EE. UU. Necesita una identificación con foto válida; los menores de 18 años necesitan documentos de sus padres.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the Workforce and Continuing Education Interest Form on the Dallas College website or call 972-669-6400.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene el formulario de interés de Educación Continua y Laboral (Workforce and Continuing Education Interest Form) en el sitio web de Dallas College o llame al 972-669-6400.
records.cost: Grant funding may be available; ask about costs
records.notes: Offered at seven Dallas College campuses: Brookhaven, Cedar Valley, Eastfield, El Centro, Mountain View, North Lake, Richland. Text line: 217-472-4745. Includes the Opportunity High School Diploma (diploma plus career certificate).

records.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas - Dallas Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help with family law, housing and eviction, public benefits, consumer debt, wills, employment, and more.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal civil gratis con asuntos de familia, vivienda y desalojos, beneficios públicos, deudas, testamentos, empleo y más.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people with low income who have a civil (not criminal) legal problem in a county served. Most applicants must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents, with exceptions for some immigrant survivors of crime or abuse.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de bajos ingresos con un problema legal civil (no penal) en un condado que atienden. La mayoría deben ser ciudadanos de EE. UU. o residentes permanentes, pero hay excepciones para algunos inmigrantes que son víctimas de delitos o abuso.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online or call the Legal Aid Line at 1-888-529-5277, Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente su solicitud en línea o llame a la Línea de Ayuda Legal al 1-888-529-5277, de lunes a viernes de 8 a.m. a 5 p.m.
records.notes: Statewide intake line: 1-888-529-5277. People on SNAP, Medicaid, SSI, WIC or in public/subsidized housing are presumed income-eligible (https://legalaidtx.org/get-help/am-i-eligible-for-legal-aid/). Does not handle criminal or personal injury cases. Walk-in volunteer attorney clinics and eviction clinics run around Dallas County.

records.name: Landlord-Tenant Hotline and Eviction Help
records.description_en: A free phone line from Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas for renters with eviction, lockout, repair, or other landlord problems. Legal Aid also runs eviction clinics at justice court offices in Dallas County.
records.description_es: Una línea telefónica gratis de Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas para inquilinos con problemas de desalojo, cambio de cerraduras, reparaciones u otros problemas con el dueño. Legal Aid también tiene clínicas sobre desalojos en las oficinas de los juzgados de paz del condado de Dallas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income renters in the Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas service area, including Dallas County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para inquilinos de bajos ingresos en el área que atiende Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas, incluido el condado de Dallas.
records.how_to_apply: Call 1-855-548-8457 Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m. If you have court papers, have them ready when you call.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 1-855-548-8457 de lunes a viernes de 8 a.m. a 5 p.m. Si tiene papeles de la corte, téngalos a la mano cuando llame.
records.notes: Act fast after receiving an eviction notice or court citation. Legal Aid serves 114 counties in North and West Texas.

records.name: Dallas Volunteer Attorney Program (DVAP)
records.organization: Dallas Volunteer Attorney Program (with Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas and the Dallas Bar Association)
records.description_en: Volunteer lawyers give free civil legal help at neighborhood clinics, including family law, housing, landlord-tenant, employment, wills, expunctions, bankruptcy, and veterans benefits.
records.description_es: Abogados voluntarios dan ayuda legal civil gratis en clínicas del vecindario, con asuntos de familia, vivienda, problemas entre inquilinos y dueños, empleo, testamentos, borrar antecedentes (expunctions), bancarrota y beneficios para veteranos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income people who meet DVAP's eligibility rules; eligibility is checked at the clinic. Criminal cases, tickets, and personal injury cases are not handled.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de bajos ingresos que cumplen con los requisitos de DVAP; se revisa en la clínica si califica. No atienden casos penales, multas ni casos de lesiones personales.
documents_needed: Copies of any legal papers (for example, if you have been sued)
records.how_to_apply: Go to a DVAP legal clinic and bring your legal papers. An attorney will interview you and decide if DVAP can help further.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya a una clínica legal de DVAP y lleve sus papeles legales. Un abogado hablará con usted y decidirá si DVAP le puede seguir ayudando.
records.notes: Clinic sites: South Dallas (MLK Community Center, 2922 Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd, 75215), West Dallas (West Dallas Multipurpose Center, 2828 Fish Trap Rd, 75212), East Dallas (Grace United Methodist Church, 4105 Junius St, 75246), and a veterans clinic at the VA Medical Center (4500 S. Lancaster Rd, 75216). Check the website for clinic dates. Legal Aid says these clinics accept walk-ins.

records.name: Human Rights Initiative of North Texas
records.organization: Human Rights Initiative of North Texas
records.description_en: Gives immigration legal services and social services to immigrants, especially people escaping abuse or violence, to help them get legal status.
records.description_es: Da servicios legales de inmigración y servicios sociales a inmigrantes, sobre todo a personas que escapan de abuso o violencia, para ayudarles a obtener un estatus legal.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For immigrants in North Texas who need immigration legal help. Help is by appointment only.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para inmigrantes en el norte de Texas que necesitan ayuda legal de inmigración. La ayuda es solo con cita.
records.how_to_apply: Call 214-855-0520 to ask for an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 214-855-0520 para pedir una cita.
records.hours: Monday-Thursday, 9:00 AM-12:00 PM and 1:00 PM-5:00 PM
records.notes: Appointment only. Cost not listed on the homepage; ask when calling.

records.name: Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP) - Dallas County
records.organization: Dallas County Health and Human Services
records.description_en: Helps pay electric and gas bills and can repair or provide heating and cooling units in a crisis.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar las facturas de luz y gas, y en una crisis puede reparar o dar equipos de calefacción y aire acondicionado.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Dallas County residents with household income at or below 150% of the federal poverty guideline, based on the last 30 days of income.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en el condado de Dallas con un ingreso familiar igual o menor al 150% de la guía federal de pobreza, según los ingresos de los últimos 30 días.
documents_needed: Proof of all household income for the last 30 days
Social Security numbers for all household members
Proof of citizenship or legal status
records.how_to_apply: Call (214) 819-1848 to schedule an appointment. No walk-ins.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (214) 819-1848 para hacer una cita. No se atiende sin cita.
records.notes: First-come, first-served; high demand means long waits on the phone. Full document list: https://www.dallascounty.org/Assets/uploads/docs/hhs/ceap/CEAP%20Program%20Requirements_2026.pdf.

records.name: DART Discount GoPass Tap Card
records.description_en: Gives people on certain assistance programs 50% off regular local DART bus and train fares.
records.description_es: Da un 50% de descuento en los pasajes locales normales de autobús y tren de DART a personas que reciben ciertos programas de ayuda.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people enrolled in SNAP, Medicaid, CHIP, Medicare, TANF, WIC, CEAP, Dallas Housing Authority or Housing Choice Voucher, or Parkland Financial Assistance.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas inscritas en SNAP, Medicaid, CHIP, Medicare, TANF, WIC, CEAP, la Autoridad de Vivienda de Dallas o el programa de vales de vivienda (Housing Choice Voucher), o la Asistencia Financiera de Parkland.
documents_needed: Current benefit card or agency letter with your name and expiration date
records.how_to_apply: Register online on the DART website, call 972-482-4052, or go to DARTmart at Akard Station. The card is mailed within about 15 business days.
records.how_to_apply_es: Regístrese en línea en el sitio web de DART, llame al 972-482-4052 o vaya a DARTmart en la estación Akard. La tarjeta le llega por correo en unos 15 días hábiles.
records.notes: The card expires when the qualifying benefit expires. Renew at DARTmart at Akard Station, 1401 Pacific Ave, Dallas 75202. Existing card questions: (972) 482-6491. DART customer service: (214) 979-1111.
